description: This file defines the CookieUtils class, providing utility methods for handling HTTP cookies, including get, add, delete, serialize, and deserialize operations, within the context of OAuth2 security in the Thingsboard project.

classes.name: CookieUtils
classes.description: Utility class for managing HTTP cookies, including serialization/deserialization and cookie operations.

methods.name: getCookie
methods.description: Retrieves a cookie by name from the HTTP request.

methods.name: addCookie
methods.description: Adds a cookie to the HTTP response with specified parameters.

methods.name: deleteCookie
methods.description: Deletes a cookie by setting its max age to zero.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes an object to a Base64-encoded string.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a cookie's value from Base64 and JSON into an object of specified class.
